description: This file defines the EmployeePunchInOutMenuConfigurator class, which implements menu configuration for the 'Employee Punch In/Out' feature in the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It sets the current module and screen to 'time' and 'viewAttendanceRecord' respectively.

classes.name: EmployeePunchInOutMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration by setting module and screen context for employee punch in/out management.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module to 'time' and screen to 'viewAttendanceRecord' for menu configuration.
